settings.site_id.label: SL site id
settings.site_id.description: Fixes this widget to one stop. Leave at 0 to use the stop picked in the panel.
settings.transport.label: Transport mode
settings.transport.description: Only show departures of this mode.
settings.direction.label: Direction
settings.direction.description: SL's direction code for the stop: 1 or 2. 0 shows both.
settings.lines.label: Lines
settings.lines.description: Only these line designations, comma separated, e.g. "4, 74".
settings.walk_minutes.label: Minutes to reach the stop
settings.walk_minutes.description: Hides departures leaving sooner than this, so the board only shows what you could still catch.
settings.bar_count.label: Departures in the bar
settings.bar_count.description: How many upcoming departures the bar label lists.
settings.forecast_minutes.label: Forecast window (minutes)
settings.forecast_minutes.description: How far ahead to ask SL for.
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between fetches. The countdown ticks every 15 seconds regardless.
settings.bar_format.label: Bar segment template
settings.show_icon.label: Show transport glyph
settings.show_icon.description: Draw the mode of the next departure in front of the label.
settings.panel_count.label: Departures in the panel
settings.panel_count.description: How many rows the board panel lists.
